rule: This is a total launch cap, not monthly authorization. Any charge taking cumulative launch spending above $50 requires explicit user approval. The $19 Shopify registration invoice is paid. Staging compute is stopped between attended tests; no new hosting subscription was purchased.

staging.notes: Metered usage before plan credits, not an invoice or confirmed card charge. Usage can lag; bucket charges are not itemized. Compute is stopped after the attended operator-audit, empty-database recovery and independent encrypted-record readback. The private volume and independent recovery bucket remain retained and metered. recoveryBucketBytes is the older measurement at recoveryBucketBytesCheckedAt; it predates later recovery snapshots and operator records. Reconcile actual launch charges against the $50 total cap.
